name: Glam makeup transformations and beauty looks
what_it_is: A cluster of short-form beauty videos in which creators show off full-glam makeup looks and transformations: step-by-step application, dramatic before/after reveals, highlighter and lash close-ups, and finished portrait-style looks. A few entries branch off into related beauty content, such as a makeup artist's client complaint skit, a cosplay dance grid, and a Russian lip-sync clip.
